topic: Checking virtual facility status in data
summary_markdown: Someone provided a query snippet to determine if a facility is virtual using `dictGetUInt32('allunite.facility_virtual_dict', 'facility_source_num', facility_num) > 0 AS is_virtual_facility`. Separately, [me] mentioned an intention to simplify the aggregation job by reducing multiple queries down to two parameterized ones.
action_items: [me] will attempt to simplify the aggregation job using fewer parameters.
